.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ')\r\n      .trim();\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const levenshtein = (a: string, b: string) => {\r\n    const m = a.length, n = b.length;\r\n    if (m === 0) return n;\r\n    if (n === 0) return m;\r\n    const dp = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => new Array(n + 1).fill(0));\r\n    for (let i = 0; i <= m; i++) dp[i][0] = i;\r\n    for (let j = 0; j <= n; j++) dp[0][j] = j;\r\n    for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {\r\n      for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {\r\n        const cost = a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1;\r\n        dp[i][j] = Math.min(\r\n          dp[i - 1][j] + 1,\r\n          dp[i][j - 1] + 1,\r\n          dp[i - 1][j - 1] + cost\r\n        );\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n    return dp[m][n];\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const similarity = (a: string, b: string) => {\r\n    const na = normalizeName(a);\r\n    const nb = normalizeName(b);\r\n    if (!na || !nb) return 0;\r\n    const dist = levenshtein(na, nb);\r\n    const maxLen = Math.max(na.length, nb.length);\r\n    const baseScore = 1 - dist / maxLen;\r\n    const substrBonus = (na.includes(nb) || nb.includes(na)) ? 0.1 : 0;\r\n    return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, baseScore + substrBonus));\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const    nome: p.nome,\r\n        score: similarity(name, p.nome)\r\n      })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, 5);\r\n      return scored;\r\n    };\r\n\r\n    const mapped = items.map(item => {\r\n      const sugg = suggestionsFor(item.name);\r\n      const best = sugg[0];\r\n      const threshold = 0.72;\r\n      const isGood = best && best.score >= threshold;\r\n      return {\r\n        originalName: item.name,\r\n        quantity: item.quantity,\r\n        matchedName: isGood ? best.nome : undefined,\r\n        matchedId: isGood ? best.id : undefined,\r\n        confidence: best ? best.score : 0,\r\n        suggestions: sugg,\r\n        selected: isGood\r\n      };\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    setMatchedItems(mapped);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const processWhatsappWithAI = async () => {\r\n    if (!whatsappMessage.trim()) {\r\n      toast({ title: 'Cole a mensagem do WhatsApp', variant: 'destructive' });\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    setIsProcessingAI(true);\r\n    try {\r\n      const SUPABASE_URL = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_SUPABASE_URL || supabase.supabaseUrl;\r\n      const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY || (supabase as any).supabaseKey;\r\n      const resp = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/process-daily-production-ai`, {\r\n        method: 'POST',\r\n        headers: {\r\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\r\n          'Authorization': `Bearer ${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}`\r\n        },\r\n        body: JSON.stringify({ dailyMessage: whatsappMessage })\r\n      });\r\n      if (!resp.ok) {\r\n        const txt = await resp.text();\r\n        throw new Error(`Erro IA: ${resp.status} ${resp.statusText} - ${txt}`);\r\n      }\r\n      const data = await resp.json();\r\n      const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items.map((it: any) => ({ name: it.name, quantity: it.quantity })) : [];\r\n      setAiItems(items);\r\n      matchAiItemsToDb(items);\r\n      toast({ title: 'Mensagem processada com IA', description: `${items.length} itens identificados` });\r\n    } catch (e: any) {\r\n      console.error('Erro IA produ├º├úo di├íria:', e);\r\n      toast({ title: 'Erro ao processar com IA', description: e?.message || 'Falha desconhecida', variant: 'destructive' });\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setIsProcessingAI(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const addSelectedAiItemsToEntries = () => {\r\n    // Permitir lan├ºar todos os itens selecionados, mesmo sem correspond├¬ncia autom├ítica\r\n    const toAdd = matchedItems.filter(mi => mi.selected && mi.quantity > 0);\r\n    if (toAdd.length === 0) {\r\n      toast({ title: 'Selecione itens para lan├ºar', variant: 'destructive' });\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    const newEntries:    }));\r\n    setProductionEntries(prev => [...prev, ...newEntries]);\r\n    toast({ title: 'Itens lan├ºados', description: `${toAdd.length} itens reconhecidos lan├ºados` });\r\n    if (productionEntries.length === 0) {\r\n      toast({ title: \"Adicione pelo menos um produto\", variant: \"destructive\" });\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    setSelectedDate(date);\r\n return;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    setIsLoading(true);\r\n\r\n    try {\r\n      const payload = productionEntries.map(entry => ({\r\n        date: selectedDate,\r\n        product_name: .insert(payload);\r\n\r\n      if (error) throw error;\r\n\r\n      toast({\r\n        title: \"Produ├º├úo registrada com sucesso!\",\r\n        description: `${productionEntries.length} produtos });\r\n\r\n      // Limpar modal\r\n      setNewProductName(\"\");\r\n      setIsNewProductModalOpen(false);\r\n\r\n      // Recarregar lista de produtos (padr├Áes + adicionados ÔêÆ exclu├¡dos)\r\n      try {\r\n        const { data: additionsData } = await supabase\r\n          .from('daily_production_products')\r\n          .select('id, name, active');\r\n\r\n        const { data: exclusionsData }\r\n      } catch (err) {\r\n        console.error('Erro ao recarregar lista de produ├º├úo ap├│s registro:', err);\r\n      }\r\n\r\n    } catch (error: any) {\r\n      console.error('Erro ao     }\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setIsCreatingProduct(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // Remover produto adicionado (custom) da lista de produ├º├úo\r\n  const removeDailyAddition = async (id:   if (error) throw error;\r\n      } else {\r\n        const { error } = await supabase\r\n          .from('daily_production_exclusions')\r\n          .insert({ loja_id: null, name, created_by: (acc[entry.product_name] ||= new Set<string>()).add(entry.date);\r\n        return acc;\r\n      }, {} as Record<string, Set<string>>);\r\n      // Lista completa de produtos, ordenada por total const monthlyTrend = Object.entries(monthlyTotals)\r\n        .map(([month, total]) => ({ month, total }))\r\n        .sort((a, b) => a.month.localeCompare(b.month));\r\n\r\n      setAnalytics({       size={isMobile ? cliques simples: exige pequeno movimento\n      activationConstraint: { distance: 8 },\n    })\n  );\n  const orderById = useMemo(() => {\n    const m = new Map<string, Encomenda>();\n    Object.values(grouped).forEach((arr) => arr.forEach((o) => m.set(o.id, o)));\n    return m;\n  }, [grouped]);\n\n  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n\n  const onDragStart sensors={sensors} onDragStart={onDragStart} onDragEnd={onDragEnd} onDragCancel={onDragCancel}>\n      <div className=\"mt-4 relative\">\n        <button\n          aria-label=\"Scroll left\"\n          className=\"absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#E6DCCF]/80 backdrop-blur-md shadow-[0_4px_12px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] border aria-label=\"Scroll right\"\n          className=\"absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#E6DCCF]/80 backdrop-blur-md <DayColumn day={d} loading={loading} onPrint={() => onPrintDay(d)}>\n                  {grouped[d.dateISO].length === 0 && !loading && (\n                    <div className=\"text-xs     </div>\n      <DragOverlay dropAnimation={dropAnimation} zIndex={10000}>\n        {activeId ?     };\r\n        fetchProfiles();\r\n    }, []);\r\n\r\n    const getUserName = (val: string | null | undefined) => {\r\n        if (!val) return \"Sistema\";\r\n        // Check if val itself is ...eventData,\r\n                        lancado_por: userName,\r\n                        status: 'planejamento'\r\n                    }]);\r\n                    if (error) throw error;\r\n setLoading(false);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const createRole = async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const name = newRoleName.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, '_');\r\n      if (!name) {\r\n        toast({ }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const startEditRole = (role: Role) => {\r\n    setEditingRoleId(role.id);\r\n    setEditedRoleDisplayName(role.display_name);\r\n    setEditedRoleDescription(role.description || Number(Number(nota.valor_total || 0).toFixed(2)),\r\n            item?.nome_produto || '',\r\n            item?.categoria || '',\r\n            item ? 256);\r\n    for (let k = max; k > 0; k--) {\r\n      if (buffer.slice(-k) === chunk.slice(0, k)) {\r\n        return buffer + chunk.slice(k);\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n    return buffer + chunk;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  function normalizeStreamText(input: string): string {\r\n    let text = input.replace(/\\r\\n/g, \"\\n\");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\*+/g, \"\");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\"+/g, \"\");\r\n    text = text.replace(/[^\\S\\n]+/g, \" \");\r\n    const dense = (() => {\r\n      const noSpaceLen = text.replace(/\\s+/g, '').length;\r\n      const spaceCount = text.length - noSpaceLen;\r\n      return text.length > 30 && (spaceCount < text.length * 0.05 || /[A-Za-z├Ç-├┐]{15,}/.test(text));\r\n    })();\r\n    if (dense) {\r\n      try {\r\n        const seg = new (Intl as any).Segmenter('pt', { granularity: 'word' });\r\n        const arr = Array.from(seg.segment(text));\r\n        let rebuilt = '';\r\n        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {\r\n          const cur = arr[i];\r\n          const prev = arr[i - 1];\r\n          if (i > 0 && prev?.isWordLike && cur.isWordLike) rebuilt += ' ';\r\n          rebuilt += cur.segment;\r\n        }\r\n        text = rebuilt;\r\n      } catch { }\r\n    }\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\n{3,}/g, \"\\n\\n\");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\s*:\\s*/g, \": \");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\s*,\\s*/g, \", \");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\s*\\.\\s*/g, \". \");\r\n    text = text.replace(/ {2,}/g, \" \").trim();\r\n    try {\r\n      const wordDedup = new RegExp('(\\\\b[\\\\p{L}0-9]+\\\\b)(?:\\\\s+\\\\1)+', 'gu');\r\n      text = text.replace(wordDedup, '$1');\r\n    } catch { }\r\n    return text;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  function mergeStreamText(prev: string, chunk: string): string {\r\n    const cleaned = normalizeStreamText(chunk);\r\n    const merged = appendOverlap(prev, cleaned);\r\n    return normalizeStreamText(merged);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const await Promise.all(ops);\r\n\r\n      setSelectedForDeletion([]);\r\n      setIsDeleteMode(false);\r\n      toast({ title: 'Itens removidos da lista', description: `${ops.length} removidos` });\r\n    } catch (e) {\r\n      console.error('Erro ao remover itens da lista de produ├º├úo:', e);\r\n      toast({ title: 'Erro ao remover itens', variant: 'destructive' });\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setIsDeletingProducts(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // Fun├º├Áes para hist├│rico\r\n  const loadHistory = async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const { data, error } = await supabase\r\n        .from('daily_production')\r\n        .select('*')\r\n        .gte('date', dateRange.start)\r\n        .lte('date', dateRange.end)\r\n        .order('date', { ascending: false });\r\n\r\n      if (error) throw error;\r\n      setHistory(data || []);\r\n    } catch (error) {\r\n      console.error('Erro ao carregar hist├│rico:', error);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const deleteHistoryEntry = async (id: string) => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const confirmed = window.confirm('Tem certeza que deseja deletar este lan├ºamento de produ├º├úo?');\r\n      if (!confirmed) return;\r\n      const { error } = });\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // Fun├º├Áes para analytics\r\n  const loadAnalytics = async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const { data, error } = await supabase\r\n        .from('daily_production')\r\n        .select('*')\r\n        .gte('date', analyticsDateRange.start)\r\n        .lte('date', analyticsDateRange.end);\r\n\r\n      if (error) throw error;\r\n\r\n      const entries = data || [];\r\n\r\n      // Calcular total de produ├º├úo\r\n      const totalProduction = entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.quantity, 0);\r\n\r\n      // Totais por produto\r\n      const productTotals = entries.reduce((acc, entry) => {\r\n        acc[entry.product_name] = (acc[entry.product_name] || 0) + entry.quantity;\r\n        return acc;\r\n      }, {} as Record<string, number>);\r\n      // Datas de produ├º├úo por produto (conjunto para evitar duplicados)\r\n      const productDatesMap = entries.reduce((acc, entry) => {\r\n        (acc[entry.product_name] ||= new Set<string>()).add(entry.date);\r\n        return acc;\r\n      }, {} as Record<string, Set<string>>);\r\n      // Lista completa de produtos, ordenada por total return acc;\r\n      }, {} as Record<string, number>);\r\n\r\n      const dailyTrend = Object.entries(dailyTotals)\r\n        .map(([date, total]) => ({ date, total }))\r\n        .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));\r\n\r\n      // Tend├¬ncia mensal (YYYY-MM) sem parse UTC: usa fatia da string\r\n      const monthlyTotals = entries.reduce((acc, entry) => {\r\n        const ym = (entry.date || '').slice(0, 7);\r\n        if (!ym) return acc;\r\n        acc[ym] = (acc[ym] || 0) + entry.quantity;\r\n        return acc;\r\n      }, {} as Record<string, number>);\r\n\r\n      const monthlyTrend = Object.entries(monthlyTotals)\r\n        .map(([month, total]) => ({ month, total }))\r\n        .sort((a, b) => a.month.localeCompare(b.month));\r\n\r\n      setAnalytics({ via DnD sem persist├¬ncia\r\n  const [historyGroups, setHistoryGroups] = useState(historyGroupsMemo);\r\n  useEffect(() => setHistoryGroups(historyGroupsMemo), [historyGroupsMemo]);\r\n\r\n  // Item });\r\n    const style: React.CSSProperties = {\r\n      transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),\r\n      transition,\r\n    };\r\n    return (\r\n      <div ref={setNodeRef} style={style}       size={isMobile ? fim de drag para um grupo de data espec├¡fico\r\n  const handleDragEndForDate = (date: string) => (event: DragEndEvent) => {\r\n    const { active, over } = event;\r\n    if (!over) return;\r\n    if (active.id === over.id) return;\r\n    setHistoryGroups((prev) => {\r\n      return prev.map((g) => {\r\n        if (g.date !== date) return g;\r\n        const oldIndex = g.entries.findIndex((e) => [selectedStore]);\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    if (hasData) {\r\n      fetchPurchaseData();\r\n    }\r\n  }, [hasData, storeId, isFactory]);\r\n\r\n  const fetchPurchaseData = async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      if (!hasData) {\r\n        setItems([]);\r\n        setLoading(false);\r\n        return;\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      setLoading(true);\r\n\r\n      // 1. STRICT CONTEXT & CATEGORY FILTERING (Client-side)\r\n      let finalItems: PurchaseAnalysis[] = (viewData || []).filter((item: any) => {\r\n        // A. STRICT STORE CHECK\r\n        const matchesStore = item.loja_id ? item.loja_id === storeId : true;\r\n        if (!matchesStore) return false;\r\n\r\n        // B. Global rule says \"embalagens\" too. We allow Insumos + Embalagens.\r\n          return isInsumos || isEmbalagens;\r\n        } else {\r\n          // Other Stores (e.g. Asas Sul):\r\n          // Allow Embalagens + Mercearia + Insumos\r\n          return isEmbalagens || isMercearia || isInsumos;\r\n        }\r\n      });\r\n\r\n      // 2. NEW LOGIC: If Factory, fetch Insumos products potentially missing from view\r\n      if (isFactory) {\r\n        // Fetch all active products in 'Insumos' sector\r\n        const { data: productsData, true)\r\n          .in('setor', ['Insumos', 'insumos', 'Estoque Insumos']);\r\n\r\n        if (prodError) {\r\n          console.error('Error fetching extra insumos:', prodError);\r\n        } else if  const existingIds = new Set(finalItems.map((i: any) => i.produto_id));\r\n\r\n          const missingProds = productsData.filter(p => !existingIds.has(p.id));\r\n\r\n          const formattedMissing: PurchaseAnalysis[] = missingProds.map(p => {\r\n            const cat = catData?.find(c => c.id === p.categoria_id);\r\n            return {\r\n              produto_id: p.id,\r\n              produto_nome: p.nome,\r\n              codigo_barras: p.codigo_barras || '',\r\n              unidade_medida: p.unidade_medida,\r\n              preco_unitario: p.preco_unitario || 0,\r\n              setor: p.setor,\r\n              categoria_nome: cat?.nome || 'Sem Categoria',\r\n              categoria_emoji: cat?.emoji || '­ƒôª',\r\n              quantidade_atual: 0,\r\n              quantidade_minima: 0,\r\n              quantidade_maxima: 100,\r\n              ultima_movimentacao: '',\r\n              percentual_estoque: 0,\r\n              status_estoque: 'sem_estoque',\r\n      });\r\n\r\n          finalItems = [...finalItems, ...formattedMissing];\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      setItems(finalItems);\r\n    } catch (error) {\r\n      console.error('Error fetching if (percentage <= 30) return \"bg-orange-500\";\r\n    if (percentage <= 60) return \"bg-yellow-500\";\r\n    return \"bg-green-500\";\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <PermissionBlur         <Leaf className=\"w-full h-full text-[#57715B] rotate-12\" />\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div className=\"absolute bottom-[-10%] left-[-15%] w-[400px] h-[400px] opacity-[0.05] </div>\r\n\r\n        <div className=\"absolute top-[20%] left-[10%] w-[200px] h-[200px] bg-[#57715B]/5 rounded-full blur-[80px] pointer-events-none\" />\r\n        <div className=\"absolute tracking-wide uppercase opacity-80\">\r\n              {isFactory ? \"Gest├úo de Reposi├º├úo & Insumos\" : \"Gest├úo de Aquisi├º├Áes\"}\r\n            </p>\r\n          </div>\r\n\r\n          <div toMinutes(b.hora_entrega);\n        if (am === bm) {\n          // Fallback: cria├º├úo\n          return new Date(a.created_at).getTime() - new Date(b.created_at).getTime();\n        }\n        return Date; dateISO: string; label: string }) => void;\n  stores?: { id: number; name: string }[];\n}) {\n  const sensors = useSensors(\n    useSensor(PointerSensor, {\n      // Evita iniciar drag em cliques simples: exige pequeno movimento\n      activationConstraint: { distance: 8 },\n    })\n  );\n  const orderById = useMemo(() => {\n    const m = new Map<string, Encomenda>();\n    Object.values(grouped).forEach((arr) => arr.forEach((o) => m.set(o.id, o)));\n    return m;\n  }, [grouped]);\n\n  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n\n  const onDragStart = (ev: DragStartEvent) => {\n    setActiveId(String(ev.active.id));\n  };\n\n  const onDragEnd = (ev: DragEndEvent) => {\n    const { active, over } = ev;\n    if (over && active?.id) {\n      const order = orderById.get(String(active.id));\n      const newDateISO = String(over.id);\n      if (order) onMove(order, newDateISO);\n    }\n    setActiveId(null);\n  };\n\n  const onDragCancel = () => setActiveId(null);\n\n  const dropAnimation = { duration: 90, easing: \"cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)\" } as any;\n  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n  return (\n    <DndContext sensors={sensors} onDragStart={onDragStart} onDragEnd={onDragEnd} onDragCancel={onDragCancel}>\n      <div className=\"mt-4 relative\">\n        <button\n          aria-label=\"Scroll left\"\n          className=\"absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#E6DCCF]/80 backdrop-blur-md shadow-[0_4px_12px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] border border-[#C5A065]/20 hover:bg-[#E6DCCF] hover:border-[#C5A065]/50 text-[#4A3728] transition-all z-30 group\"\n          onClick={() => scrollRef.current?.scrollBy({ left: -800, behavior: \"smooth\" })}\n        >\n          <ChevronLeft className=\"w-5 h-5 opacity-70 group-hover:opacity-100 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform\" />\n        </button>\n        <button\n          aria-label=\"Scroll right\"\n          className=\"absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#E6DCCF]/80 backdrop-blur-md dark:from-[#0A0A0A] dark:to-transparent rounded-r-2xl hidden md:block z-10\" />\n\n        <div ref={scrollRef} className=\"overflow-x-auto scroll-smooth relative z-0\">\n          <div className=\"flex gap-4 items-stretch snap-x snap-mandatory\">\n            {weekDays.map((d) => (\n              <div key={d.dateISO} className=\"snap-start shrink-0 min-w-[320px]\">\n                <DayColumn day={d} loading={loading} onPrint={() => onPrintDay(d)}>\n                  {grouped[d.dateISO].length === 0 && !loading && (\n                    <div className=\"text-xs         name: item.nome_produto,\r\n            requested: Number(item.quantidade_solicitada) || 0,\r\n            sent: item.quantidade_enviada ?? // Se o contexto global indica que n├úo estamos em sess├úo, mas o estado local ainda reflete sess├úo ativa\r\n    else if (!isInSession && isSessionMode) {\r\n      console.log('Sincronizando estado .channel('requisicoes_realtime')\r\n        .on(\r\n          'postgres_changes',\r\n          {\r\n            event: '*',\r\n            schema: 'public',\r\n            table: {\r\n            event: '*',\r\n            schema: 'public',\r\n            table: 'digital_separation_items'\r\n          },\r\n          (payload) => {\r\n   separated_at: updatedItem.separated_at\r\n          };\r\n\r\n          // Mostrar notifica├º├úo espec├¡fica baseada no tipo de atualiza├º├úo\r\n          if (updatedItem.is_separated &&       }\r\n\r\n          return updatedItems;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return currentItems;\r\n      });\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  // Lidar com atualiza├º├Áes dos itens de separa├º├úo digital\r\n 256);\r\n    for (let k = max; k > 0; k--) {\r\n      if (buffer.slice(-k) === chunk.slice(0, k)) {\r\n        return buffer + chunk.slice(k);\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n    return buffer + chunk;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  function normalizeStreamText(input: string): string {\r\n    let text = input.replace(/\\r\\n/g, \"\\n\");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\*+/g, \"\");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\"+/g, \"\");\r\n    text = text.replace(/[^\\S\\n]+/g, \" \");\r\n    const dense = (() => {\r\n      const noSpaceLen = text.replace(/\\s+/g, '').length;\r\n      const spaceCount = text.length - noSpaceLen;\r\n      return text.length > 30 && (spaceCount < text.length * 0.05 || /[A-Za-z├Ç-├┐]{15,}/.test(text));\r\n    })();\r\n    if (dense) {\r\n      try {\r\n        const seg = new (Intl as any).Segmenter('pt', { granularity: 'word' });\r\n        const arr = Array.from(seg.segment(text));\r\n        let rebuilt = '';\r\n        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {\r\n          const cur = arr[i];\r\n          const prev = arr[i - 1];\r\n          if (i > 0 && prev?.isWordLike && cur.isWordLike) rebuilt += ' ';\r\n          rebuilt += cur.segment;\r\n        }\r\n        text = rebuilt;\r\n      } catch { }\r\n    }\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\n{3,}/g, \"\\n\\n\");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\s*:\\s*/g, \": \");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\s*,\\s*/g, \", \");\r\n    text = text.replace(/\\s*\\.\\s*/g, \". \");\r\n    text = text.replace(/ {2,}/g, \" \").trim();\r\n    try {\r\n      const wordDedup = new RegExp('(\\\\b[\\\\p{L}0-9]+\\\\b)(?:\\\\s+\\\\1)+', 'gu');\r\n      text = text.replace(wordDedup, '$1');\r\n    } catch { }\r\n    return text;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  function mergeStreamText(prev: string, chunk: string): string {\r\n    const cleaned = normalizeStreamText(chunk);\r\n    const merged = appendOverlap(prev, cleaned);\r\n    return normalizeStreamText(merged);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const
